current_evidence: The document text says the council reverted to National Requirements from 1 April 2021. The council's 'Submitting a planning application' page still says it follows national standards and that the local list is guidance only, and searches found no newer Boston local list.

issues.detail: The council planning page describes the guidance list as 'adopted in early 2019', but the guidance PDF itself is dated April 2021. The workbook date matches the PDF, so this is only an inconsistency on the council's side to be aware of.

summary: Grokbot's link works and its finding is correct: Boston uses national requirements only (since 1 April 2021), and its local document is guidance. Only minor points were noted.
